homepage.selectedProductsDescription: Fresh mushrooms, canned sterile, pouch retort, frozen, to ready-supply processed products for your business needs.
homepage.b2bOrderProcessDescription: Three structured steps for procuring mushroom supplies for restaurants, catering, hotels, and food processing industries.
homepage.step1Desc: Determine commodity variants (fresh mushrooms, canned sterile, or pouch retort) and estimated quantity needed for your business.
homepage.step2Desc: Choose refrigerated fleet (cold chain) to maintain temperature freshness, regular cargo, or pick up directly from Purwodadi factory.
homepage.step3Desc: Get instant invoice details. Our operations team is ready to process orders and coordinate loading schedules in real-time.
homepage.qualityStandardsDescription: High-altitude farming facilities and integrated processing by PT Eka Timur Raya in Pasuruan.
homepage.feature1Desc: Garden in Nongkojajar, 1,850 mdpl. Stable climate for premium button mushroom growth.
homepage.feature2Desc: Harvested every morning, sorted by size and integrity for commercial kitchens.
homepage.feature3Desc: Canned and sterile pouch retort processed at Purwodadi facility with locked freshness.
homepage.feature4Desc: Serving continuous volumes for restaurants, hotels, catering, and food manufacturing.
homepage.fleetAndLogisticsDescription: Flexible delivery options designed to maintain hygiene and freshness of commodities until they reach your facility.
homepage.aboutDescription: Established in 1999 in Purwodadi, Pasuruan. Focused on B2B market with consistent, sterile, and nutritious supply.
homepage.aboutFacility: Integrated facilities from Nongkojajar garden to sterile canned and pouch production lines ready for your business needs.
homepage.ctaTitle: Ready to supply your mushroom business needs?
homepage.ctaDescription: Consult product specifications, volume, packaging, or private label needs with our team.

fleet.coldChainDesc: Special refrigerated truck to ensure fresh button mushrooms don't wilt, change color, and remain crispy when they arrive at your kitchen.
fleet.dryFleetDesc: Safe distribution for sterile canned mushroom products and long-shelf-life pouch retort, packed with layered cardboard and moisture-proof pallets.
fleet.selfPickupDesc: Direct access to our warehouse and loading dock facility in Purwodadi, Pasuruan. Partners are free to use their own logistics fleet according to schedule.
